resources.string: Control agents anywhere can reach Bridgit through a relay. The phone keeps one outgoing connection, so nothing on it is open to the internet.
This build has no relay address. Enter one under Advanced.
No relay control agents yet. Add one and give it the setup text.
The relay passes along the requests you allow and can read them on the way.
End-to-end encrypted. Only this phone and the control agent can read it.
%1$s can no longer reach this phone through the relay.
Connector (recommended): works with any assistant that can send web requests or use MCP. The relay can read requests in transit and passes along only what you allow.
Sealed: end-to-end encrypted, so the relay can\'t read anything. The control agent needs its own key and the sealed helper.
Requests wait at most 30 minutes, then they\'re deleted. While the phone is in deep sleep, delivery can be delayed.
This phone needs a relay address first. Add one in Relay settings.
This relay address belongs to a different phone. In Relay settings, enter the address for this phone. It should end in /d/%1$s.
Only for a relay you run yourself, from its owner page.
Paste these on your relay\'s owner page at %1$s/admin/. They hold no secrets.

Lost phone: Turn off here stops the relay on this phone at once. On a relay you run yourself, Disable device on its owner page also cuts it off remotely; a relay you didn\'t set up can\'t do that yet.
From the sealed helper on the control agent\'s computer.
Paste the control agent\'s public key first.
Everything this phone offers is allowed. You can narrow it with Choose permissions.
Shown once. If it\'s lost, revoke the control agent and add it again.
Connector: the relay can read requests to the routes you allowed.

You can use my Android phone through Bridgit's relay (no Tailscale needed).

Send each request as POST %1$s/jobs?wait=30 with the header "Authorization: Bearer %2$s" and a JSON body like {"deadline": <now in ms + 120000>, "request": {"method": "GET", "path": "/v1/guide"}}. The phone's answer is in response.body_base64. Every path below goes in request.path.

%3$s

Setup details:
%4$s
No Tailscale needed. Give %1$s the setup and it can start right away.
Paste it into a chat with %1$s.
%1$s reads the guide and starts using the phone.
These identify this phone to a relay you run yourself. They hold no secrets.
Open %1$s/admin/ and sign in as owner.
Paste the keys and tap Enrol phone.
Enter the one-time code under Advanced here.
In Claude, open Customize › Connectors › Add › Add custom connector.
Name it “%1$s”, paste the connector URL, then tap Add.
Tap Connect. On the Bridgit page, paste the relay key, then tap Allow.
Open ChatGPT on the web. Choose Plugins › + › Add custom MCP server.
Name it “%1$s”. Paste the connector URL, choose OAuth, then Create as a plugin.
Install and connect. On the Bridgit page, paste the relay key and tap Allow.
%1$s can\'t control this device while it is on.
